items.title: [Feature Request]: hiding Electron browser window from the applications windows list

type.name: Enhancement
type.description: A request, idea, or new functionality

items.body:
### Preflight Checklist

- [X] I have read the [Contributing Guidelines](https://github.com/electron/electron/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md) for this project.
- [X] I agree to follow the [Code of Conduct](https://github.com/electron/electron/blob/main/CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md) that this project adheres to.
- [X] I have searched the [issue tracker](https://www.github.com/electron/electron/issues) for a feature request that matches the one I want to file, without success.

### Problem Description

- I'm trying to make a browser window on the `macOS`, but I don't want to make it visible on `the application windows list`.
- On `Windows OS`, I'm using the perfect below options that did the job, and clicking on `Alt + Tab` will not show the window to the list of windows, while the same options on macOS will add the browser window to `the application windows list` via clicking on `F3` key.

```js
        focusable: false,
        transparent: true,
        alwaysOnTop: true,
        skipTaskbar: true,
        frame: false,
```

### Proposed Solution

Providing options for the browser window on `macOS` to prevent adding it to `the application windows list` as `Window OS`.

### Alternatives Considered

Any alternative options from your side will be appreciated if there.
Thanks in advance!

### Additional Information

_No response_
